title: OU variational testing gives an explicit rare-face stability modulus

setting.channel: Y=sqrt(t) X+sqrt(v) Z with v=1-t and Var(X)=1
setting.rare_chart_coupling: Couple each signed radius of X_(c,z) to the same-sign Rademacher atom.

scope_guard: The estimate is a one-sided variational lower bound for the declared Gaussian channel. It does not assert Fisher continuity for arbitrary weakly convergent laws or an unrestricted stationary lower theorem.
